# Great Yuan #1: Appoint / Recall Pacification Marshal
oe_y7_act_appoint_marshal = {
    icon = grant_a_triumph
    type = situation
    show_message = no
    potential = {
        scope:actor = { tag = CHI }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = { tag = CHI }
    }
    cooldown = { type = oe_y7_act_appoint_marshal_cd years = 3 }
    price = price:oe_y7_rtr_price_prestige_low
    ai_tick = monthly
    ai_tick_frequency = 6
    automation_tick = never
    automation_tick_frequency = 12
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = situation
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_situation"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = {
            situation:red_turban_rebellions = this
            situation_is_active = yes
        }
    }
    effect = {
        scope:actor = {
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_act_marshal_mod years = 3 mode = replace }
        }
        oe_y7_add_shi_direct = { amount = 8 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    global_var:oe_y7_phase ?= 2
                    AND = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_sway global_var:oe_y7_sway >= 1 }
                }
            }
            oe_y7_add_court = { amount = -6 }
            oe_y7_sway_add = { n = 1 }
            oe_y7_rtr_sync_sit_vars = yes
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        add = 15
        if = {
            limit = { scope:actor = { at_war = yes } }
            add = 25
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_shi global_var:oe_y7_shi < 50 }
            add = 20
        }
    }
}

            situation_is_active = yes

    effect = {

                limit = { inflation >= 0.15 }
                add_inflation = -0.025
                add_stability = 7
                if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_on } oe_yc_add_trust = { amount = 6 } }
            }
            else = {
                add_gold = oe_y7_chao_payout
                add_inflation = 0.02
                if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yc_on } oe_yc_add_trust = { amount = -4 } }

        }
        oe_y7_rtr_sync_sit_vars = yes
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        add = -10
        if = {
            limit = { scope:actor = { OR = { gold < 120 inflation >= 0.15 } } }
            add = 35
        }
    }
}

        column = { data = name }
        visible = {

            situation_is_active = yes
        }
    }
    effect = {
        scope:actor = {
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yh_famine } remove_country_modifier = oe_yh_famine }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yh_short } remove_country_modifier = oe_yh_short }
        }
        location:dadu = {
            if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_yh_famine_dadu } remove_location_modifier = oe_yh_famine_dadu }
            if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_yh_short_dadu } remove_location_modifier = oe_yh_short_dadu }
            province = { change_province_food = 400 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { location:luxian = { owner ?= c:CHI } }
            location:luxian = { province = { change_province_food = 400 } }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_on } oe_yh_add_grain = { amount = 120 } }
        oe_y7_add_shi_direct = { amount = 5 }
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        add = 5
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yh_tier global_var:oe_yh_tier <= 1 }
            add = 45
        }
    }
}

    type = situation
    show_message = no
    potential = {
        scope:actor = {
            NOT = { tag = CHI }
            is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:red_turban_rebels
        }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:red_turban_rebels
        }
    }
    cooldown = { type = oe_y7_act_rebel_tuntian_cd years = 4 }
    price = price:oe_y7_rtr_price_gold_med
    ai_tick = monthly
    ai_tick_frequency = 6
    automation_tick = never
    automation_tick_frequency = 12
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = situation
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_situation"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = {
            situation:red_turban_rebellions = this
            situation_is_active = yes
        }
    }
    effect = {
        scope:actor = {
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_act_tuntian_mod years = 5 mode = replace }
            capital ?= {
                province = { change_province_food = 300 }
                province = {
                    every_location_in_province = {
                        limit = { has_owner = yes owner ?= scope:actor }
                        change_control = 0.05
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        add = 10
        if = {
            limit = { scope:actor = { gold >= 120 } }
            add = 20
        }
    }
}
